I got really amazed what things we can achieve with our simple laptop from creating webpages, predictive models and to running billion dollar complex algorithms.
With hope so making some couples of millions I learnt so many technologies like full-stack development, machine learning and operating system.
I’m driven by my curiosity and making myself capable so that I can deliver my best wherever I’m going and working.
